title: The *Mandate*
dek: Democrats took Congress and $3 trillion in AI stocks vanished before a single bill was filed. The regulation moment labs managed around just became electoral mandate.

stories.short: Dem sweep: mandate, no law yet
stories.headline: The mandate exists. The bill does not. That gap is where the next 60 days live.

stories.short: Freshman rep calls to ban ASI
stories.headline: The ban-ASI position moved from fringe advocacy to freshman caucus in one election cycle.

stories.label: Hong Kong cameras to carry AI facial recognition by 2028
stories.headline: Hong Kong is building the proof of concept that the oversight debates elsewhere are optional.

stories.label: Nvidia fell as data center permitting became a political risk
stories.headline: Nvidia down 9%. Hyperscalers up. The market priced data center risk, not AI risk.
Meta bought the multi-agent coordination layer before the market agreed it needed one.
The transmit side of AI accountability is built. The receive side is not yet public.

stories.label: of VRAM needed to run Kimi K3.1 Pro locally
stories.headline: Frontier capability is a two-week lag from proprietary to accessible enterprise use.

still_signal: An election, a $3T selloff, an acquisition, an open-weight release, and a police deployment arrived in 48 hours from rooms that don't communicate. That is the authorization gap.
